column1: Compliance Package Name (Mandatory, write the exact name of the compliance package where item you want to edit belongs to.)
column2: Item ID (Mandatory, write the Item ID of item you want to edit.)
column3: Compliance Strategy (Mandatory, can be one of the following numbers: 1 for Compliant, 2 for Not Applicable, 3 for Not Compliant)
column4: Owner (Optional. Accepts multiple user logins or group names separated by "|" with a mandatory prefix. For example: Group-Admin|User-John). You can get the login of an user account from Settings / Organization & Access / Users or name of a group from Settings / Organization & Access / Groups.)
column5: Efficacy (Optional, can be empty or one of the following numbers: 0 for 0%, 10 for 10%, 20 for 20%, 30 for 30%, 40 for 40%, 50 for 50%, 60 for 60%, 70 for 70%, 80 for 80%, 90 for 90%, 100 for 100%)
column7: Findings (Optional, accepts multiple names separated by "|". You need to enter the name of a finding, you can find them at Compliance Management / Compliance Analysis Findings.)
column8: Internal Controls (Optional, accepts multiple names separated by "|". You need to enter the name of a control, you can find them at Controls Catalog / Internal Controls.)
column9: Policies (Optional, accepts multiple names separated by "|". You need to enter the name of a policy, you can find them at Controls Catalog / Policies.)
column10: Compliance Exception (Optional, accepts multiple names separated by "|". You need to enter the name of an exception, you can find them at Compliance Management / Compliance Exceptions.)
column11: Projects (Optional, accepts multiple names separated by "|". You need to enter the name of a project, you can find them at Security Operations / Project Management.)
column12: Asset Risks (Optional, accepts multiple names separated by "|". You need to enter the name of a risk, you can find them at Risk Management / Asset Risk Management.)
column13: Third Party Risks (Optional, accepts multiple names separated by "|". You need to enter the name of a risk, you can find them at Risk Management / Third Party Risk Management.)
column14: Business Risks (Optional, accepts multiple names separated by "|". You need to enter the name of a risk, you can find them at Risk Management / Business Impact Analysis.)
column15: Liabilities (Optional, accepts single name. You need to enter the name of a liability, you can find them at Organization / Liabilities.)
column16: Assets (Optional, accepts multiple names separated by "|". You need to enter the name of an asset, you can find them at Asset Management / Asset Identification.)
